public/panoramas/mars.jpg.title: Full-Circle Panorama Beside Namib Dune on Mars (PIA20284)
public/panoramas/mars.jpg.processing: NASA white-balanced photographic mosaic covering 360 degrees horizontally. Approximate cylindrical-to-equirectangular resampling, diffuse edge extension for missing zenith/nadir and sky, resized to 3072x1536. Not a complete spherical photograph.
